scripts.setup: npm install && node scripts/ensure-env.mjs && npm run db:wait -w server && npm run db:generate -w server && npm run db:deploy -w server && npm run db:seed -w server
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
